integrity: New proof and finite exact verifier supplied in the same artifact collection. Exact checks are not a substitute for the infinite-limit proof. No external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Poisson convergence applies in compact interior spatial bands, not to the unrestricted global simplicial count. The global expectation is only lower-bounded. Historical-priority risk remains because the 1988 model-origin paper could not be inspected in full; a stronger unidentified published theorem may imply the claim.
title: An inhomogeneous marked Poisson law for simplicial vertices of uniform random interval graphs
